name: pythia_70m
description: Configuration for pythia_70m. Backward-compatible with single-prompt scripts and compatible with prompt-suite batch scripts.

model.recommended_role: Tiny GPT-NeoX-family model for first-pass debugging of all hook and prompt-suite pipelines.

notes: Use eager attention for intervention/debugging rather than faster fused attention.
Keep use_cache=false until KV-cache interventions are implemented explicitly.
Set cache_dir in this config, pass --cache-dir, or export HF_HOME/HF_HUB_CACHE to choose where model files are stored.

global_defaults.note: Mechanistic intervention is safest with use_cache=false. Attention tensors scale as sequence_length^2.

default.description: Factual next-token recall probe. The target should tokenize as exactly one token for the current scripts.

activation_patching.description: Patch final-token hidden state from clean into corrupt. Clean/corrupt token lengths should match.
